content.value_statement: Software teams need current, context-aware guidance before choosing an implementation approach. This skill compares trusted sources and project patterns to produce practical recommendations with trade-offs.
actual_capabilities: Researches official documentation, standards, and trusted community sources for software engineering guidance.
Inspects existing project files and conventions before recommending changes.
Compares implementation approaches by benefits, costs, risks, and contextual fit.
Evaluates code quality, API design, security, and performance using included reference checklists.
Produces structured recommendations with rationale, alternatives, implementation steps, pitfalls, and sources.
limitations: The bundled guidance targets 2025, so newer framework or standards changes require fresh source research.
Scripts, assets, and several references named in SKILL.md are not included in this package.
Recommendation quality depends on the project context and source material available to the agent.
The skill provides guidance but does not write, execute, test, or deploy production changes.

use_cases.title: Choose an implementation pattern
use_cases.description: Compare practical approaches for authentication, error handling, state management, or another development task.

use_cases.title: Make an architecture decision
use_cases.description: Evaluate architecture options against scale, team experience, delivery time, maintenance, and infrastructure constraints.

use_cases.title: Review engineering practices
use_cases.description: Assess an existing project against security, performance, API design, and code quality guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Learn a best practice
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain current best practices for [topic] in [language or framework]. Ask for any project context needed before recommending an approach.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when you need a clear introduction to one engineering topic.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two approaches
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [approach A] and [approach B] for [use case]. Consider complexity, security, performance, maintenance, and team experience.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when choosing between known implementation options.

prompt_templates.title: Review an existing implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current [feature or subsystem] against relevant best practices. Cite project files, identify strengths and gaps, then propose prioritized improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when a project already contains code that the agent can inspect.

prompt_templates.title: Build an evidence-based decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the best architecture for [system]. Account for [constraints], compare at least three options, cite authoritative sources, and provide a staged migration plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a high-impact decision requiring detailed evidence and trade-off analysis.

output_examples.input: What is the best authentication approach for a React application with an existing API?
output_examples.output: Primary recommendation: use an established OpenID Connect flow and secure server-managed sessions when the backend supports them. Compare this with token-based alternatives, then verify deployment constraints.

output_examples.input: Review our API pagination approach and recommend improvements.
output: Current approach: summarize the observed pagination pattern and cite relevant project files.
Recommendation: choose cursor or offset pagination based on data size, ordering stability, and client navigation needs.
Next steps: define limits, response metadata, error behavior, documentation, and compatibility tests.

output_examples.input: Should a small team use a monolith or microservices for a new product?
output_examples.output: Start with a modular monolith unless independent scaling or deployment boundaries are already proven. Document module boundaries and define measurable conditions for later service extraction.

best_practices: Provide the stack, project maturity, constraints, and success criteria before requesting a recommendation.
Ask for official or primary sources when guidance depends on current framework behavior.
Validate recommendations with project tests, measurements, and security review before production adoption.
anti_patterns: Do not request generic guidance without sharing important technical and organizational constraints.
Do not treat a popular pattern as mandatory when a simpler option meets the requirements.
Do not apply recommendations directly to production without verification and an appropriate migration plan.

faq.question: What topics can this skill research?
faq.answer: It covers architecture, code quality, testing, security, performance, API design, tooling, and related software engineering decisions.

faq.question: Does it inspect my existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. It can read and search available project files to understand current patterns and cite relevant locations.

faq.question: Does it use current online sources?
faq.answer: It can search and fetch web sources when those tools are available. Ask for source dates because bundled guidance targets 2025.

faq.question: Will it implement the recommendation?
faq.answer: No. The declared tools support reading and research, not writing files or running implementation commands.

faq.question: How are alternatives compared?
faq.answer: The skill considers benefits, drawbacks, complexity, security, performance, maintenance, team skills, and project constraints.

faq.question: Are its recommendations guaranteed to be correct?
faq.answer: No. Verify source currency, project assumptions, measurements, tests, and security requirements before adopting a recommendation.
